recentItems.title: Pentagon flag unfurled to mark 25th anniversary of the 9/11 attacks
recentItems.description:
(11 Sep 2026) 
RESTRICTION SUMMARY:

DVIDS
Washington DC - 11 September 2026
++NIGHT SHOTS/FADES FROM SOURCE++
1. Mid of official singing U.S. national anthem
2. Various of U.S. flag being unfurled on Pentagon building 
3. Mid of man singing U.S. national anthem
4. Zoom out of U.S. flag on Pentagon building 
5. Mid of man singing U.S. national anthem
6. Mid of flag on Pentagon building
7. Mid of piper playing bagpipes 
8. Mid of flag 
9. Mid of piper
STORYLINE:
The U.S. national flag was unfurled at the Pentagon at dawn on Friday to honor the victims of the September 11, 2001, attacks.

Americans are commemorating the 25th anniversary of 9/11, remembering the shock, the dead and the sweeping consequences of the al-Qaida attacks on symbols of U.S. might and prosperity.

On September 11, 2001, al-Qaida extremists hijacked four commercial jets and crashed them into New York's World Trade Center, the Pentagon and a field near Shanksville, Pennsylvania.

Friday's milestone anniversary will bring memorial rituals — wreath-laying, flag-flying, moments of silence, vigils and readings of victims' names — and volunteer projects in tribute to a day that about half of U.S. adults remember as the most historic event of their lifetime, according to a new poll.

recentItems.title: Perú: Rubio concluye su gira por Sudamérica, centrada en la lucha contra los cárteles de la droga
recentItems.description:
(11 Sep 2026) 
Peru Rubio Visita SP  
Source: ASSOCIATED PRESS
No additional restrictions beyond those terms outlined in your license agreement.

Vídeo de AP grabado por Mauricio Muñoz
Perú: Rubio concluye su gira por Sudamérica, centrada en la lucha contra los cárteles de la droga——————————————————————————————————————————-
ASSOCIATED PRESS
Lima, Perú - 10 de septiembre de 2026

El secretario de Estado Marco Rubio prometió el jueves que Estados Unidos no actuará militarmente contra narcotraficantes en América Latina sin la aprobación de sus aliados, aun cuando el gobierno del presidente Donald Trump lleva un año con una campaña de ataques mortales contra presuntas embarcaciones de droga en aguas internacionales.

En rueda de prensa junto a Rubio la presidenta peruana Keiko Fujimori hizo un anuncio.

SOUNDBITE (Español) Keiko Fujimori, presidenta de Perú:
“Como presidenta constitucional del Perú, me alegra informar a nuestro país que el Perú formará parte del Escudo de las Américas”.

SOUNDBITE (Inglés) Marco Rubio,  Secretario de Estado de los Estados Unidos de América:
“En definitiva, la razón por la que contamos con un escudo es porque decidimos actuar en colaboración con nuestros aliados”, dijo Rubio. 
El llamado “Escudo de las Américas”, es una coalición de países afines en la región, encabezada por Estados Unidos, para llevar a cabo operaciones militares conjuntas contra los cárteles de la droga. 

SOUNDBITE (Inglés) Marco Rubio,  Secretario de Estado de los Estados Unidos de América:
¿”Contra qué es un escudo? Es un escudo contra estas amenazas a la soberanía de estas naciones independientes. Es un escudo contra estos grupos criminales transnacionales que, en muchos casos, cuentan con más dinero y mejor equipamiento militar que el propio Estado. Eso es inaceptable, y la única forma de derrotarlos es hacerles frente con firmeza”, dijo Rubio. 
Fujimori hizo un comentario para aclarar sobre el respeto de la Constitución de su país.

SOUNDBITE (Español) de Keiko Fujimori, presidenta de Perú:
“Cada vez que hay un ingreso de tropas a nuestro país, se pide un permiso especial al Congreso de la República, y esto por supuesto se va a mantener”.

ANNE MARIE GARCIA, ASSOCIATED PRESS
STORYLINE:
El secretario de Estado Marco Rubio prometió el jueves que Estados Unidos no actuará militarmente contra narcotraficantes en América Latina sin la aprobación de sus aliados, aun cuando el gobierno del presidente Donald Trump lleva un año con una campaña de ataques mortales contra presuntas embarcaciones de droga en aguas internacionales.

De pie junto a la nueva presidenta peruana, Keiko Fujimori, Rubio les dijo a los periodistas que, si bien Washington tiene “la capacidad de actuar unilateralmente”, preferiría trabajar con sus aliados porque esa es “la manera más efectiva de hacerlo”.

Efectuó sus comentarios poco después de que Fujimori anunciara que Perú se había sumado al “Escudo de las Américas”, una coalición de países afines en la región —encabezada por Estados Unidos— para llevar a cabo operaciones militares conjuntas contra los cárteles de la droga. Colombia, a la que Rubio visitó esta semana, también se incorporó recientemente al grupo bajo el gobierno de su nuevo presidente Abelardo de la Espriella.

“Nosotros estamos dispuestos a cumplir con todo lo posible para ayudarlos, pero obviamente esto va a ser basado en la cooperación que ustedes pidan", declaró Rubio el jueves. "No queremos hacer menos de lo que piden, pero tampoco vamos a hacer más de lo que ustedes piden”.

recentItems.title: Israel destroys Hezbollah’s underground infrastructure on Ali Taher ridge in southern Lebanon
recentItems.description:
(11 Sep 2026) 
RESTRICTIONS SUMMARY 

ASSOCIATED PRESS
Nabatiyeh, Lebanon - 11 September 2026
1. Various of debris on Ali Taher hill
2. Various of traffic and people instreet
3. Various of men at vegetable shop
4. SOUNDBITE (Arabic) Mohamed Jaara, vegetable seller:  
“Of course, there is fear. We’re living through this right now, and no one knows what’s going to happen. Every day there are airstrikes, every day there is shelling. Every day we don’t know what’s going to happen to us. We are standing our ground, but how long can we keep holding on? No one knows. Only God knows."
5. Pan of damage 
6. SOUNDBITE (Arabic) Mahammad Jaber, local resident: 
“There is no safety. There is absolutely no safety. We feel unsafe about everything because the bombardment continues, relentless, ceaseless shelling. Just a short while ago, they launched raids on Nabatieh al-Fawqa, Kfar Remman."
7. Various of people playing backgammon
8. SOUNDBITE (Arabic) Abu Shakir Borjeh, local resident: 
“There is no fear. Personally, I’m not worried, and the young people aren’t worried either. They are playing backgammon, and there is no shelling in the city of Nabatieh."
9. Various of plumes of smoke billowing 
10. Various of Ali Taher hill with church in foreground
STORYLINE:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Defense Minister Israel Katz have said that the Israeli military has destroyed Hezbollah’s underground infrastructure on the strategic Ali Taher ridge in southern Lebanon.

The ridge has been the site of clashes between Israeli forces and Hezbollah in recent weeks. 

Residents of nearby areas in Lebanon heard loud explosions Thursday, and videos on local media showed a large fire on the ridge. 

There was no immediate statement from Hezbollah.

In Nabatiyeh, the sound of explosions and the sight of smoke rising from nearby hills added to concerns among residents already living under the threat of renewed hostilities.

Vegetable seller Mohamed Jaara said constant Israeli strikes and shelling have left many people uncertain about their future.

“Of course, there is fear. We’re living through this right now, and no one knows what’s going to happen," he said

"Every day there are airstrikes, every day there is shelling. Every day we don’t know what’s going to happen to us. We are standing our ground, but how long can we keep holding on? No one knows."

Netanyahu and Katz's statement on Thursday said the infrastructure and a command center on the ridge were built over two decades with Iranian funding and planning and "were intended to serve as a base for the conquest of the Galilee."

It said the destruction completed Israel’s "operational control" over the ridge above and below ground.

recentItems.title: The treasure trove of Aardman animation puppets up for auction
recentItems.description:
(11 Sep 2026) 
RESTRICTIONS SUMMARY: 

ASSOCIATED PRESS
London - 10 September 2026
1. Various of Will Becher looking at Wallace stop-motion puppet
2. SOUNDBITE (English) Will Becher, director and animator, Aardman: ++STARTS ON SHOT 1++
"People love the fact that these feel like real characters. Real people in their own world."
3. Various of Sian Taylor examining Feathers McGraw stop motion puppet from Vengeance Most Fowl (2024)
4. SOUNDBITE (English) Sian Taylor, auction manager, Propstore: ++STARTS ON SHOT 3++
"Typically we would put an estimate on them, but something like this has never been done before. To have a collection this incredible directly from Aardman, there's nothing comparable."
5. Mid of a puppet
6. SOUNDBITE (English) Will Becher, director and animator, Aardman:
++STARTS ON SHOT 5 AND PARTLY COVERED BY SHOT 7++
"These are like highly engineered instruments. They are puppets, we call them puppets because the animators are physically moving them. So they're robust in that we can move them and they hold in position. But if I dropped him on the floor, which we have in the past done to puppets, the worst thing is that his face which is made of clay is going to get squashed and covered in dirt. So then we’d spend the next two hours re-sculpting, cleaning and making it nice again. But everything about the costume is designed to look like clay, but is often silicone so that we can have the different colors but also the textures in there. It moves like clay, but it’s a lot quicker for us to work with."
7. Various of puppets
8. SOUNDBITE (English) Will Becher, director and animator, Aardman:
++STARTS ON PREVIOUS SHOT AND PARTLY COVERED BY SHOT 9++
"Actually this Wallace is incredibly unique, and I think that's possibly why he's stood next to me now, because there is only one of him. We have tended on feature films to make maybe 12 or 15 multiples of the same character when we're working with Shaun, for example. Each one designed so the animators can work simultaneously."
9. Close of puppet
10. Mid of puppets
STORYLINE:
Animation fans around the world have a rare chance to own a piece of British cinematic history as Aardman auctions off over 220 iconic puppets and memorabilia. 

The sale coincides with the studio's 50th anniversary with profits being reinvested in training a new generation of animators. 

The auction marks the British studio's 50th anniversary, with every lot starting at an opening bid of £100.

Bidding officially opened on September 4, leading up to a live global auction on September 24, 2026.  

The catalogue features over 220 items spanning nearly every production in the Bristol studio’s half-century , offering fans a unique opportunity to own a piece of animation history.

Headlining the sale are screen-matched stop-motion puppets of Wallace, Gromit, and the villainous Feathers McGraw—complete with his signature red glove disguise—from the 2024 film Vengeance Most Fowl. 

There are no estimates being provided for any of the lots because of the rare nature of the sale.

The lineup also features a Shaun the Sheep puppet from the upcoming 2026 feature Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom. 

AP Video by Tom Rayner

recentItems.title: High school stabbing in Croatia leaves two wounded and attacker detained
recentItems.description:
(11 Sep 2026) 
RESTRICTION SUMMARY: 

ASSOCIATED PRESS
Zagreb, Croatia – 11 September 2026
1. High school where the attack happened
2. Wide of journalists and a police officer blocking the entrance
3. Police officer blocking way
4. Journalists at the scene
5. SOUNDBITE (Croatian) Ana Dasovic, mother of a student:
“I left my son in front of the school. He normally had the first class at 8 am, he is in the first grade. Just before half past eight, he called me in panic, saying, ‘Mother, mother, something happened at the school. I saw the attacker. He had a knife and a mask, and he attacked another student. I just asked, "Where are they now, and what is happening?" He said that they had hidden in a class on the second floor. I told him to stay there, listen to the teachers, and don’t panic and calm down.”
6. Police officer 
7. Police tape
8. SOUNDBITE (Croatian) Ana Dasovic, mother of a student:
“The whole situation is incredible. These are 15-year-old children.  As I spoke with my son, some of the children were left, some were kept until the police finishes the work, but there was no danger any more for them. It is a procedure.”
9. Two police officers
STORYLINE:
A student in a high school in Croatia's capital, Zagreb, on Friday stabbed and wounded another student and a janitor, authorities said.

The attacker was detained. Croatia's Ministry of Education said he used a “sharp object” in the attack. 

The student who was attacked received surgery for multiple stab wounds but was out of danger and the school employee suffered face injuries, the authorities said. 

The Index news portal reported the attack followed a falling-out between the students on Thursday. 

Videos from the scene show the building cordoned off during a police investigation. 

In December 2024, a knife-wielding former student walked into a school in Zagreb, stabbed a 7-year-old girl to death and wounded three more children and their teacher. He was convicted and sentenced to 50 years in prison. 

The attack prompted schools in Zagreb and elsewhere to hire guards to prevent unauthorized access.

recentItems.title: Tibetans in exile in New Delhi protest Chinese President Xi’s participation in BRICS 2026
recentItems.description:
(11 Sep 2026) 
RESTRICTION SUMMARY:

ASSOCIATED PRESS 
New Delhi - 11 September 2026 
1. Mid of marching protesters sloganeering (English): "What we want? We want freedom" and in Hindi "China China, Leave Tibet" 
2. Pan of protesters marching and shouting (Hindi): "China China, Leave Tibet"
3. Mid of protesters marching and shouting (Hindi): "This is our slogan, Tibet is our country" 
4. Mid of protesters marching and shouting (English): "What we want? We want freedom" 
5. Mid of protesters shouting (Hindi): "Long live Dalai Lama"
6. Mid of protester shouting (Hindi): ‘Stop bloodshed in Tibet’ 
7. SOUNDBITE (English) Wangdue Dorjee, Member of Tibetan Parliament in exile: 
“I want to send a message to Xi Jinping that Tibet is not dead. We are still alive and we will continue to protest against the Chinese occupation over Tibet and the repression which is happening inside Tibet. That’s why we have gathered here and we are opposing the Chinese communist government.” 
8. Protesters sloganeering (Hindi): "Remember remember, 1962 remember" (reference to the Sino-Indian war of 1962) 
9. Protesters shouting (Hindi): "Down with Xi Jinping" 
10. Protesters dragging posters of Xi's caricature with their feet
11. Protesters marching holding a banner, reading (English) "Simon Go Back (Done), Xi Jinping Go Back (...)", chanting (Hindi): "Down with Xi Jinping"
12. SOUNDBITE (English) Yeshi Phunksok, Former Deputy Speaker, Tibetan Parliament in exile: 
“We raise [issues of] human rights, and the protection of Tibet’s environment, and then the Tibetan culture. So once they are talking about culture, environment, security: this is the main issue for India and India’s neighboring countries, and universal [issues]. So that is the reason the entire Tibetan community came here to raise (voice) against the Chinese government policies.” 
13. Tibetan protesters singing Tibetan song before the march began holding banner, reading (English): ‘"Xi you’re not welcome" and "Simon Go Back (Done), Xi Jinping Go Back (...)’"
14. Protester standing on poster showing AI generated caricature of Xi
15. SOUNDBITE (English) Wangdue Dorjee, Member of Tibetan Parliament in exile: 
“It is my urgent appeal to the United Nations, and to the international community especially, particularly to the BRICS (Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa) countries to put a pressure over the Chinese government to control or to stop all the massive constructions over the Tibetan plateau.” 
16. Protester wearing a T shirt reading (English): "I am Tibetan first", another protester wearing Tibetan flag 
STORYLINE:
Around 150 members of the Tibetan Youth Congress protested in New Delhi on Friday against Chinese President Xi Jinping’s scheduled visit to India for the BRICS (Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa) summit.

Xi is scheduled to arrive in New Delhi on Saturday for the two-day summit and is expected to hold talks with the Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi.

Protesters chanted slogans such as "Down with Xi Jinping ’, and "Stop bloodshed in Tibet" while marching near the Tibetan settlement in the north of India's capital, New Delhi.

Wangdue Dorjee, a Member of Tibet's parliament-in-exile, said the community will "continue to protest against the Chinese occupation over Tibet and the repression which is happening inside Tibet.”

“I want to send a message to Xi Jinping that Tibet is not dead," he said.

The protesters condemned the participation of the Chinese President in the BRICS 2026 summit.


India considers Tibet to be part of China, although it hosts tens of thousands of Tibetans in exile.

recentItems.title: China Foreign Ministry briefing highlights
recentItems.description:
(11 Sep 2026) 
RESTRICTIONS SUMMARY:

ASSOCIATED PRESS
Beijing, China -  11 September 2026
Spokesperson: Mao Ning

1.What is China's expectation for the upcoming BRICS Summit in New Delhi?

China attaches great importance to and actively participates in BRICS cooperation. At this meeting, President Xi Jinping will attend and deliver an important speech, engage in in-depth exchanges with leaders of other countries on major issues including the current international situation, the development of the BRICS mechanism and deepening practical cooperation, put forward important Chinese initiatives, and provide strategic direction for the high-quality development of greater BRICS cooperation.
China is willing to work with all BRICS partners to ensure that greater BRICS cooperation makes steady and sustained progress and to make BRICS contributions to building a community with a shared future for mankind.

2.What is China's expectation for the meeting between President Xi Jinping and Prime Minister Modi, the first one since their last meeting in Tianjin during the Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit last year? 

China and India are making arrangements for a bilateral meeting between President Xi Jinping and Indian Prime Minister Modi. This will be the third consecutive year that the two leaders have met, following their meetings in Kazan and Tianjin. 
China is ready to work with India to follow the strategic guidance of the leaders of the two countries, handle China-India relations from a strategic and long-term perspective, strengthen communication, enhance cooperation, properly manage differences, and be friends committed to good-neighborliness and amity, and partners that contribute to each other's success.

3.Does China have any priorities in the agenda during the BRICS Summit given ongoing conflicts in the Middle East and between Ukraine and Russia? 

China advocates a common, comprehensive, cooperative and sustainable vision of security. We are committed to promoting the political settlement of the hotspot issues through dialogue. We also look forward to working with BRICS countries to encourage all parties to resolve disputes through dialogue and negotiation and jointly safeguard regional and world peace and stability. 

4.U.S. artificial intelligence company Anthropic issued a report Thursday saying that it has disrupted operation believed to be linked with China using their models to engage in malicious activities. What is the Foreign Ministry's comment?

I am not aware of the specifics you mentioned. China is committed to promoting the development of AI for good and for all. At the same time, we firmly oppose any distortion of facts or attacks and smears against China.

5.Taiwan official Hsiao Bi-khim is visiting Italy. What is the Foreign Ministry's response?

China has already made solemn demarches to the Italian and European sides over the Taiwan independence politician‘s visit to Italy to attend relevant meetings. The DPP authorities and certain politicians are racking their brains to seek attention everywhere, using the pretext of democracy and freedom to rely on external forces in pursuit of Taiwan independence. Such behavior is contemptible and futile.
There is only one China in the world, and Taiwan is an inalienable part of China's territory. China always firmly opposes any form of official interaction between Taiwan and countries that have diplomatic relations with China. 



7.China announced an increase in visa fees for Japanese citizens traveling to China. What is the Foreign Ministry's comment?



STORYLINE:

recentItems.title: New Delhi residents face traffic chaos as India prepares to host BRICS summit
recentItems.description:
(11 Sep 2026) 
RESTRICTION SUMMARY

ASSOCIATED PRESS
New Delhi - 11 September 2026
1. Various of workers making a flower display of BRICS (Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa) logo 
2. Various of a barricaded road in New Delhi, vehicles waiting
3. SOUNDBITE (English) Rishi Lekhi, The Associated Press:
“Parts of one of the busiest urban centers in the world have turned into tightly controlled security zones, with thousands of police and para military personnel deployed across the city.”
4. Tracking shot of a partly opened market in New Delhi
5. SOUNDBITE (English) Rishi Lekhi, The Associated Press:
In order to control traffic and public movement in the city, the authorities have announced a public holiday today. Although the residents of Delhi are very proud to be hosting such a prestigious summit, the traffic woes and chaos is testing their patience to the limit.”
6. Various of posters of Russian President Vladimir Putin, Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chinese President Xi Jinping on a roundabout in New Delhi.
STORYLINE:
As India’s capital, New Delhi prepares to host a summit of the BRICS grouping of countries this Saturday and Sunday, parts of one of the world’s busiest urban centers have been turned into tightly controlled security zones.

Even as many Delhi residents are proud to play host to a gathering of world leaders, the traffic chaos is testing their patience and prompting widespread complaints about how the city plans for major events. 

BRICS is a grouping of 11 major emerging markets and developing countries, named after an acronym for Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa.

Thousands of police and paramilitary personnel were deployed Friday, with barricades, checkpoints and traffic curbs in place across major roads and key areas a day before the summit begins Saturday. 

City authorities also declared it a public holiday in an effort to reduce traffic and limit movement across the city.

Government offices, schools and many private businesses were closed, reducing traffic and giving security agencies greater control over movement. Some schools shut their doors on Thursday. 

Similar measures were imposed in 2023, when New Delhi hosted the G20 summit.

Officials said the restrictions were necessary to ensure the smooth running of the major multilateral gathering. 

They urged residents to work from home where possible, plan journeys in advance and follow official traffic advisories. 

But millions of Delhi residents still needed to go to work. 

Office workers, delivery drivers and daily wage earners reported difficulties reaching work as roads were closed, routes diverted, and traffic restrictions changed. 

Russian President Vladimir Putin, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian are among the leaders expected to attend the summit Saturday and Sunday.

BRICS has expanded from its original membership to include 11 countries that together represent about half the world’s population and a significant share of global energy, resources and economic output. 

The group has sought a larger role in a global order long dominated by the United States and its Western allies and has gained support in parts of the Global South, where countries have criticized Western-led financial institutions.

El-Alamein city, Egypt - 9 September 2026

"We showcase products such as attack drones, guided munitions, and autonomous (defense) systems."

15. Wide of Lockheed Martin, American defense company, stand and displays 
16. Grey helicopter model 
17. Wide of Egyptian Amstone Group Exhibition 
18. SOUNDBITE (Arabic) Retired Brig General Mohamed Sayed, consultant at Amstone Company:
"We have more than one surprise at the exhibition today. First, right behind me is a guided bomb weighing approximately 1,000 kilograms (2204.62 pounds); after being dropped from the aircraft, it travels 100 kilometres (62 miles) to its target at a speed of about 700 kilometres (434.96 miles) per hour."

19. Mid of a guided bomb GK-100

STORYLINE:
Fighter jets performed white-knuckle manoeuvres as part of a showcase of aerial capabilities at Egypt's second International Aviation and Space Exhibition in el-Alamein. 

The exhibition displayed some of the latest developments in aviation, navigation technology, and included a range of aircraft and defense systems.

The outdoor space was lined with latest military aircrafts for visitors to see, hailing from different countries such as Turkey and the UAE. 

Indoors, various sections were filled with rockets, as well as drone and helicopter models. International and local companies displayed missiles and quadcopters too. 

An Egyptian exhibitor called Amstone Group showed a guided bomb weighing approximately 2200 pounds on display.

Egyptian President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi attended the exhibition on its first day of opening.

The Egypt International Aviation and Space Exhibition 2026 ended on Thursday.
